crossRefs.note: Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.
Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved.
We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn’t love his brother…

people.name: Ampliatus
people.line: Believer greeted by Paul in Rome
